pmid:42929693.reason: SAFFRON phase 3 shows PFS and final OS benefit for osimertinib-savolitinib over platinum-pemetrexed after osimertinib in MET-overexpressed/amplified disease.

practice_change.basis: SAFFRON, randomised open-label phase 3, n=338, osimertinib+savolitinib vs platinum-pemetrexed after osimertinib progression (MET IHC3+/FISH>=10); primary PFS by BICR HR 0.55 (95% CI 0.42-0.72), final OS HR 0.68 (0.50-0.91); 12-mo PFS 36% vs 10%.

pmid:42929702.reason: DeLLphi-305 phase 3 shows large OS gain from adding tarlatamab to durvalumab maintenance in ES-SCLC.

practice_change.basis: DeLLphi-305, randomised open-label phase 3, n=563, tarlatamab+durvalumab vs durvalumab maintenance after first-line chemoimmunotherapy; primary OS median 21.1 vs 12.7 mo, HR 0.42 (95% CI 0.32-0.54); PFS 7.4 vs 1.9 mo, HR 0.34 (0.28-0.42); interim analysis.

pmid:42929675.reason: Krascendo 1 phase 3 shows PFS and OS benefit of divarasib over sotorasib/adagrasib in previously treated KRAS G12C NSCLC.

practice_change.basis: Krascendo 1, randomised open-label phase 3, n=338, divarasib vs sotorasib or adagrasib; primary PFS 9.8 vs 5.7 mo, HR 0.58 (95% CI 0.44-0.76); OS 17.7 vs 12.0 mo, HR 0.56 (0.41-0.78); grade 3-4 TRAEs 24.6% vs 34.5%.
